Here’s a ready‑to‑go, 7‑day Paris itinerary that balances culture, cuisine, and a touch of luxury—perfect for a first‑time visitor or a seasoned traveler looking to hit the highlights without feeling rushed. Feel free to tweak any day or swap activities to match your interests or budget. --- ## 📅 7‑Day Paris Itinerary (Mid‑April 2025) | Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | |-----|---------|-----------|---------| | **Day 1 – Arrival & Settling In** | • Arrive at Charles de Gaulle (or Orly).
• Take the RER B to **Champs‑Élysées‑Clemenceau** (or use a private transfer).
• Check into a boutique hotel in the 8th arrondissement (e.g., Hôtel Le Six, Hotel Le Meurice, or a well‑rated Airbnb). | • Light stroll along the **Eiffel Tower** (skip the tower itself if you’re not planning to go up).
• Lunch at **Café Constant** (classic French bistro). | • Dinner at **Le Cinq** (Michelin‑starred) or a cozy bistro like **Le Petit Cler**.
• Optional: Seine river cruise (Bateaux Mouches) to see the city lights. | | **Day 2 – Classic Landmarks** | • Breakfast at **Café de Flore** (Saint‑Germain‑des‑Près).
• Visit the **Louvre Museum** (arrive early, 9 am). | • Lunch at **Ladurée** on the Champs‑Élysées.
• Walk to **Tuileries Garden** → **Place de la Concorde** → **Arc de Triomphe**. | • Dinner at **L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon** (French haute cuisine). | | **Day 3 – Montmartre & Artistic Vibes** | • Breakfast at **Le Pain Quotidien** near Sacré‑Coeur.
• Explore **Montmartre**: Sacré‑Coeur, Place du Tertre, and the **Espace Dalí**. | • Lunch at **La Maison Rose** (iconic Montmartre spot).
• Visit **Musée de Montmartre** or the **Moulin Rouge** (optional show). | • Dinner at **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** (famous steakhouse). | | **Day 4 – Day Trip to Versailles** | • Early train (RER C) to **Palace of Versailles**.
• Guided tour of the palace and gardens. | • Picnic lunch in the gardens (pick up baguette, cheese, wine).
• Explore the **Grand Trianon** and **Queen’s Hamlet**. | • Return to Paris.
• Light dinner at **Le Petit Bouchon** (Burgundy‑style). | | **Day 5 – Modern & Contemporary** | • Breakfast at **Café Kitsuné** (modern vibe).
• Visit **Centre Pompidou** (modern art). | • Lunch at **Le Georges** (restaurant on the Pompidou roof).
• Walk to **La Défense** for contemporary architecture. | • Dinner at **Septime** (Michelin‑starred, modern French). | | **Day 6 – Hidden Gems & Shopping** | • Breakfast at **Du Pain et des Idées** (best croissants).
• Explore **Le Marais**: **Picasso Museum**, **Place des Vosges**, boutique shopping. | • Lunch at **L’As du Fallafel** (best falafel in Paris).
• Visit **Musée Carnavalet** (history of Paris). | • Dinner at **Le Comptoir du Relais** (bistro in Saint‑Germain). | | **Day 7 – Departure** | • Brunch at **Café Charlot** (classic Parisian café).
• Last‑minute souvenir shopping at **Boulevard Haussmann** (Galeries Lafayette). | • Pack & check‑out. | • Transfer to airport. | --- ## ✈️ Travel & Transportation | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Flights** | Book a round‑trip from your home city to Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY). Look for airlines with good reviews (Air France, KLM, Lufthansa). | | **Airport Transfer** | • **RER B** (cheapest, ~€10 per person).
• **Private shuttle** (≈€50–70).
• **Taxi** (≈€60–80). | | **Public Transport** | • Purchase a **Paris Visite** pass (valid for 2–5 days, unlimited metro/bus/RER).
• Or buy a **carnet** of 10 single‑ride tickets (€14.90). | | **Day Trip to Versailles** | • RER C from **Saint‑Germain‑des‑Près** to **Versailles Château‑Rive‑Gaîté** (≈€7.50 each way).
• Entry fee: €20 (adult). | | **Parking** | Not recommended; use public transport. | --- ## 🏨 Accommodation Options | Budget | Recommendation | Approx. Cost per Night | |--------|----------------|------------------------| | **Luxury** | Hôtel Le Meurice, Four Seasons George V, Mandarin Oriental | €600–€900 | | **Mid‑Range** | Hôtel Le Six, Hotel Henriette, Hotel Le Petit Palais | €150–€250 | | **Budget** | Generator Paris, Hotel Ekta, Airbnb in 11th arrondissement | €70–€120 | *Tip:* Book early (at least 3–4 months) for best rates, especially if traveling during spring festivals. --- ## 🍽️ Dining Highlights | Dish | Restaurant | Why | |------|------------|-----| | Croissants & Café au lait | Du Pain et des Idées | Best croissants in Paris | | Steak frites | Le Relais de l’Entrecôte | Legendary steakhouse | | French pastry | Ladurée | Iconic macarons | | Modern French | Septime | Michelin‑starred, seasonal | | Traditional bistro | Le Petit Cler | Authentic Parisian vibe | --- ## 🎟️ Must‑See Attractions (Tickets) | Attraction | Ticket Price (Adult) | Notes | |------------|----------------------|-------| | Louvre | €17 (free on first Sunday of month) | Book online to skip lines | | Eiffel Tower | €25.90 (second floor) | Skip the summit if you’re not going up | | Musée d’Orsay | €14 | Free on first Sunday of month | | Centre Pompidou | €14 | Free on first Sunday of month | | Palace of Versailles | €20 | Book online, includes gardens | --- ## 💰 Budget Breakdown (per person, excluding flights) | Category | Cost | |----------|------| | Accommodation (mid‑range) | €1,050 (7 nights) | | Food & Drinks | €350 | | Attractions & Tickets | €200 | | Transport (metro + day trip) | €80 | | Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | €100 | | **Total** | **≈ €1,780** | *(Adjust based on your accommodation choice and dining preferences.)* --- ## 📌 Quick Tips 1. **Language** – Learn a few basic French phrases; locals appreciate the effort. 2. **Cash vs. Card** – Most places accept cards, but keep €20–€30 in cash for small cafés or markets. 3. **Weather** – Mid‑April is mild (10–18 °C). Pack layers, an umbrella, and comfortable walking shoes. 4. **Safety** – Keep an eye on your belongings in crowded areas; pickpocketing can happen near major attractions. 5. **Cultural Etiquette** – Greet with “Bonjour” before asking for help; always say “Merci” and “Au revoir.” --- ### Ready to book? - **Flights**: Use Google Flights or Skyscanner to compare prices. - **Accommodation**: Book through Booking.com or directly on hotel sites for best rates. - **Tickets**: Purchase Louvre, Eiffel Tower, and Versailles tickets online in advance to avoid queues. Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you’d like to adjust the itinerary (e.g., add a wine tasting, a day in the Latin Quarter, or a night at a jazz club), just let me know. Bon voyage!
